import pandas as pd,numpy as np
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');p=pd.read_parquet('passages.parquet')
c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['late']=w.year>=1876
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages
print(((w.year//10*10)!=w.decade).sum())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack()
  return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
e=est(w);rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
groups=[g.r.values for _,g in w.groupby(['genre','late'])]
keys=list(w.groupby(['genre','late']).groups.keys())
for i in range(2000):
  m={k:rng.choice(v,len(v)).mean() for k,v in zip(keys,groups)}
  gs=sorted(set(k[0] for k in keys))
  bs.append(np.mean([m[(g,True)]-m[(g,False)] for g in gs]))
print(e,np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for dc in ['high','medium','low']: print(dc,est(w[w.date_confidence==dc]))
print('hi+med',est(w[w.date_confidence!='low']))
print('ex1866-85',est(w[(w.year<1866)|(w.year>=1886)]))
print('1856-1895',est(w[(w.year>=1856)&(w.year<1896)]))
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,est(w[w.origin==o]))
print('single ed',est(w[w.n_editions==1]))
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
p['dt']=p.domains.apply(lambda x:'DISTANCE_TRAVEL' in list(x))
pp=p[p.dt].merge(w[['work_id','year','genre']],on='work_id')
print(pp.sort_values('confidence',ascending=False).groupby(pp.year>=1876).head(4)[['passage_id','year','genre','technology_named']])
"
